"""
URL: https://leetcode.com/problems/airplane-seat-assignment-probability/description/?envType=problem-list-v2&envId=vn57k9wr

1227. Airplane Seat Assignment Probability

n passengers board an airplane with exactly n seats. The first passenger has lost the ticket and picks a seat randomly. But after that, the rest of the passengers will:

- Take their own seat if it is still available, and
- Pick other seats randomly when they find their seat occupied

Return the probability that the nth person gets his own seat.

Example 1:

Input: n = 1
Output: 1.00000
Explanation: The first person can only get the first seat.

Example 2:

Input: n = 2
Output: 0.50000
Explanation: The second person has a probability of 0.5 to get the second seat (when first person gets the first seat).

Constraints:

    1 <= n <= 10^5
"""


class Solution:
    def nthPersonGetsNthSeat(self, n: int) -> float:
        if n == 1:
            return 1.0
        return 0.5


sol = Solution()

print(sol.nthPersonGetsNthSeat(1))  # 1.0

assert abs(sol.nthPersonGetsNthSeat(1) - 1.0) < 1e-5
assert abs(sol.nthPersonGetsNthSeat(2) - 0.5) < 1e-5

assert sol.nthPersonGetsNthSeat(3) == 0.5
assert sol.nthPersonGetsNthSeat(10) == 0.5
assert sol.nthPersonGetsNthSeat(100) == 0.5
assert sol.nthPersonGetsNthSeat(1000) == 0.5
assert sol.nthPersonGetsNthSeat(100000) == 0.5
assert sol.nthPersonGetsNthSeat(99999) == 0.5
assert sol.nthPersonGetsNthSeat(4) == 0.5
assert sol.nthPersonGetsNthSeat(5) == 0.5
assert sol.nthPersonGetsNthSeat(6) == 0.5
assert sol.nthPersonGetsNthSeat(7) == 0.5
assert sol.nthPersonGetsNthSeat(8) == 0.5
assert sol.nthPersonGetsNthSeat(9) == 0.5
